title: Mr. Joshua
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds of a 400 m run, 30 GHD sit-ups and 15 heavy deadlifts, for time. Honours Navy SEAL Special Warfare Operator 1st Class Joshua Thomas Harris, who drowned during combat operations in Afghanistan in 2008. 150 GHD sit-ups is a lot of hip flexor and spine work: newer athletes should do fewer or use floor sit-ups.
